course_name_en: Applications of Artificial Intelligence in Companies
prerequisites: None. Competencies acquired in the modules Object-Oriented Programming and Algorithms and Data Structures are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: explain basic concepts and methods of Artificial Intelligence
describe and evaluate the benefits of AI for companies
identify suitable AI methods for defined business processes to support and automate them
independently design AI solutions for simple problems and given datasets and implement prototypes using standard libraries

syllabus_topics: Use and preparation of data in companies
Integration of AI into business processes
Practice-relevant AI applications (e.g. sentiment analysis, contract review, customer support, …)
Solving business problems with the use of AI

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of these assignments. The examination performance consists of software development (3 LP) and either an oral examination (individual examination, 3 LP) or a written examination (3 LP). Grading is done on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Business Informatics program.
bibliography: Russel, Stuart and Norvig, Peter. “Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach”. Pearson. 2022.
